title: coleus nitidus
intro: Coleus nitidus, commonly known as Coleus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, with reported health benefits including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Coleus nitidus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its potential to lower blood pressure and reduce pain. Additionally, the plant's therapeutic actions may also include its potential to act as an adaptogen, helping the body to adapt to stress and promoting relaxation.
